sources.title: DFT-Quality Adsorption Simulations in Metal-Organic Frameworks Enabled by Machine Learning Potentials
sources.role: Primary DFT-derived interaction-potential reference for ZIF-8/CO2
sources.notes: The model uses distinct guest labels: CO2 carbon is Co and CO2 oxygen is Os. These labels are model types, not physical elements.

sources.title: MLIP-MC: A Framework for Adsorption Simulations using Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
sources.role: Protocol and qualitative cross-check for universal MLIPs
sources.notes: Reports systematic underbinding for MACE-MP-0a and overbinding for later MACE-MP variants; the preprint is not an experimental reference.

sources.title: H2, N2, CO2, and CH4 Unary Adsorption Isotherm Measurements at Low and High Pressures on Zeolitic Imidazolate Framework ZIF-8
Experimental and molecular simulation study of CO2 adsorption in ZIF-8: Atomic heat contributions and mechanism
sources.role: External plausibility range for low-loading adsorption heat
sources.notes: The approximately 16 kJ mol^-1 value is not treated as an exact single-temperature ground truth.

sources.title: CRAFTED: An exploratory database of simulated adsorption isotherms of metal-organic frameworks
sources.notes: CRAFTED is a simulation baseline and is not ground truth.

sources.title: Data-efficient fine-tuning of foundational models for first-principles quality sublimation enthalpies
sources.role: Methodological basis for a later adsorption-specific MACE fine-tuning stage
sources.notes: Demonstrates data-efficient MACE-MP-0 fine-tuning for molecular crystals, but does not provide ZIF-8/CO2 adsorption reference values.
